name: intelyide-site
description: Static download website for IntelyIDE. No dependencies; deployed with wrangler (npm run deploy).

scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs --prod && npx --yes wrangler@4.147.0 deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-site.mjs --prod && npx --yes wrangler@4.147.0 deploy --dry-run
